data.body: Plan rewritten per user design decision (2026-08-08). Verified the git-remote-s3 v0.3.2 library API against installed source: S3Remote exposes acquire_lock/release_lock (its own IfNoneMatch/60s-TTL/steal lock — remote.py:352), get_bundles_for_ref (enumeration), remove_remote_ref, and .s3 (its boto3 client for delete_object); parse_git_url yields (scheme,profile,bucket,prefix). Doctor.fix_multiple_bundles is interactive (input() at manage.py:137,141) AND discards the non-chosen head — confirming it is unusable. This dissolves all 7 prior BLOCK findings: (1,2,5) NO merge=union — reuse rebar's existing lossless multi-parent merge (sync._union_merge; UUID event dirs never collide; .bridge_state/* merge=ours); (3,7) NO reinvented DOCTOR marker — reuse the helper's acquire_lock/release_lock; (4,6) enumeration+delete via the helper's own S3Remote/.s3 client, boto3 transitive under [s3], no core dep. Epic ACs unchanged (observable outcomes identical; only mechanism changed).
